Montenegro thinks that Alfonso VI legitimized Sancho probably coinciding with the meeting of a council in Carrión de los Condes in January 1103 because from that date onwards, Sancho began to confirm royal charters before his brothers-in-law Raymond and Henry of Burgundy.

Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Edmund was killed in 946, and succeeded by his brother Eadred. The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle records that Eadred "reduced all the land of Northumbria to his control; and the Scots granted him oaths that they would do all that he wanted".

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology

Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: The Northumbrian submission to Eadred led to a meeting with the notables of York led by Archbishop Wulfstan in 947, but the following year King Erik was back ruling Northumbria and Eadred laid waste to the southern parts of the kingdom— Ripon is mentioned as a particular target—to force the Northumbrians to expel Erik, which they did. The following year, 949, by which time Blacáire was dead and Amlaíb's brother ruling in Dublin, the Northumbrians invited Amlaíb to rule in York.

Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: The main beneficiary was the brother of Amlaíb's new wife Dúnflaith, Domnall ua Néill, who became the next High King of Ireland.

Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: The marriage linked Amlaíb not only to the northern Uí Néill kindred of Cenél nEógain, but also to the southern Clann Cholmáin as he was now stepfather to Dúnflaith's young son Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology

Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: In 960 the Annals of Ulster report that Cammán, son of Amlaíb mac Gofrith, was defeated at an unidentifiable place named Dub.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Sitriuc and his brothers appear to have raided _____ after this, but disappear from the record soon afterwards and do not appear to have returned to Ireland
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Sitriuc and his brothers appear to have raided Munster after this, but disappear from the record soon afterwards and do not appear to have returned to Ireland.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Amlaíb's activities in the early 960s seem largely to have been limited to occasional raids in _____
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Two years later one Sitriuc Cam—Cam means crooked or twisted and Cammán is simply the hypocoristic form of this byname, so that Sitriuc Cam and Cammán are presumed to be the same person—was defeated by the Dubliners led by Amlaíb Cuarán and the Leinstermen while raiding in Leinster. Amlaíb's activities in the early 960s seem largely to have been limited to occasional raids in Leinster.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Another raid south in 964 ended in a heavy defeat for Amlaíb near Inistogue (modern _____) at the hands of the Osraige
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Another raid south in 964 ended in a heavy defeat for Amlaíb near Inistogue (modern County Kildare) at the hands of the Osraige.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Having defeated these, in 968 he marched south and plundered _____, killing several notables, and laid siege to Dublin for two months
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: He attacked Kildare in 964, and it was a target again in 967 when Muiredach mac Faeláin, abbot of Kildare, a member of the Uí Dúnlainge kindred which ruled Leinster, was killed by Amlaíb and Cerball mac Lorcáin, a kinsman of Muiredach's. Until the late 960s Domnall ua Néill, Congalach's successor as would-be High King, was occupied with enemies close to home, and in Connacht and Munster, and did not intervene in Leinster or the hinterlands of Dublin.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: A pursuit by ua Néill's allies was defeated near Ardmulchan (_____)
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: A pursuit by ua Néill's allies was defeated near Ardmulchan (County Meath).

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Domnall mac _____ was married to a daughter of Amlaíb, perhaps at about this time

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology

Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Domnall of Brega and Amlaíb fought against Domnall ua Néill's northern army at Kilmona in modern County Westmeath.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: The battle at _____ did not end the war in the midlands
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Domnall of Brega and Amlaíb fought against Domnall ua Néill's northern army at Kilmona in modern County Westmeath. The battle at Kilmona did not end the war in the midlands.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: This campaign appears to have established _____ ua Néill as effective overlord of the midlands and Leinster for some years
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Domnall's army, which included allies from Ulaid, was defeated, and Ardgal mac Matudáin, king of Ulaid, and Cináed mac Crongilla, king of Conaille Muirtheimne, were among those killed. Monasterboice and Dunleer were burned after the battle and fighting spread to the lands of Clann Cholmáin the following year when Domnall ua Néill's enemies there drove him out, only for him to return with an army and ravage both Mide and the lands around Dublin before marching south to attack Leinster.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: In 977, in unknown circumstances, _____ ua Néill's sons Congalach and Muirchertach were killed and Amlaíb is given credit for their deaths by the annals
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Monasterboice and Dunleer were burned after the battle and fighting spread to the lands of Clann Cholmáin the following year when Domnall ua Néill's enemies there drove him out, only for him to return with an army and ravage both Mide and the lands around Dublin before marching south to attack Leinster. This campaign appears to have set up Domnall ua Néill as effective overlord of the midlands and Leinster for some years.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Domnall made no effort to avenge the deaths, retiring to the monastery at _____ where he died in 980

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: The Dubliners campaigned against _____ the late 970s
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: This campaign appears to have set up Domnall ua Néill as effective overlord of the midlands and Leinster for some years. The Dubliners campaigned against Leinster the late 970s.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: The overking of _____, Úgaire mac Túathail, was captured in 976
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: The Dubliners campaigned against Leinster the late 970s. The overking of Leinster, Úgaire mac Túathail, was captured in 976.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: He was evidently ransomed or released as he was killed, along with _____ mac Riain of Uí Cheinnselaig of south Leinster, fighting against the Dubliners in 978 at Belan (County Kildare)
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: He was evidently ransomed or released as he was killed, along with Muiredach mac Riain of Uí Cheinnselaig of south Leinster, fighting against the Dubliners in 978 at Belan (County Kildare).

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Úgaire's successor _____ was little more fortunate, being captured by the Dubliners the following year
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Úgaire's successor Domnall Claen was little more fortunate, being captured by the Dubliners the following year.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Following the death of _____ ua Néill, Amlaíb's stepson Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill claimed the title
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Following the death of High King Domnall ua Néill, Amlaíb's stepson Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill claimed the title.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Máel _____ had become king of Mide and head of Clann Cholmáin in 975 and had inaugurated his reign with an attack on his stepfather when he burned "Thor's Wood" outside Dublin
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Following the death of High King Domnall ua Néill, Amlaíb's stepson Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill claimed the title. Amlaíb's former ally Domnall son of Congalach had died in 976, removing one potential rival, and as Amlaíb had killed two of Domnall ua Néill's sons he may have cleared the way for Máel Sechnaill to take power.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: In _____áel Sechnaill had the support of the Leinstermen when he faced Amlaíb's sons—Amlaíb himself was by now an old man—near the hill of Tara
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: In 980 Máel Sechnaill had the support of the Leinstermen when he faced Amlaíb's sons—Amlaíb himself was by now an old man—near the hill of Tara.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: The Dubliners too had allies as the Irish annals record the presence of warriors from the Isle of Man or the _____
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: The Dubliners too had allies as the Irish annals record the presence of warriors from the Isle of Man or the Hebrides.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Máel _____ occupied the city and imposed a heavy tribute on the citizens
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: In 980 Máel Sechnaill had the support of the Leinstermen when he faced Amlaíb's sons—Amlaíb himself was by now an old man—near the hill of Tara. Amlaíb's son Ragnall (Rögnvaldr) was among the dead in the battle which followed, and although several kings fighting alongside Máel Sechnaill were killed, the result was clearly a crushing blow for Dublin.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology

Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Amlaíb's son Ragnall (Rögnvaldr) was among the dead in the battle which followed, and although several kings fighting alongside Máel Sechnaill were killed, the result was clearly a crushing blow for Dublin. In the aftermath of this defeat Amlaíb abdicated, or was removed from power.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: He was replaced by a son named Glúniairn (Járnkné), a son of Dúnlaith and thus Máel _____'s half-brother
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Amlaíb's son Ragnall (Rögnvaldr) was among the dead in the battle which followed, and although several kings fighting alongside Máel Sechnaill were killed, the result was clearly a crushing blow for Dublin. Máel Sechnaill occupied the city and imposed a heavy tribute on the citizens.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Among his wives was _____, daughter of Murchad mac Finn, King of Leinster, and future wife of Brian Boru
Amlaíb Cuarán.fact: Among his wives was Gormflaith, daughter of Murchad mac Finn, King of Leinster, and future wife of Brian Boru. Gormflaith's son Sitric Silkbeard was king of Dublin after Glúniairn's death.

Amlaíb Cuarán.subject: Environment & Ecology
Amlaíb Cuarán.question: Gormflaith's son _____ was king of Dublin after Glúniairn's death

Asian elephant.fact: Elephas originated in Sub-Saharan Africa during the Pliocene and spread throughout Africa before expanding into the southern half of Asia. The earliest Elephas species, Elephas ekorensis, is known from the Early Pliocene of East Africa, around 5–4.2 million years ago.
